title: Show HN: Needle - Gemini Tool Calling Distilled to 26M Model
description: A demonstration of distilling Gemini's tool-calling capabilities down to a 26M parameter model, showing how expensive AI capabilities can be compressed into much smaller, efficient models suitable for edge deployment.
author: cactus-compute (Henry Ndubuaku)

title: Show HN: Agentic interface for mainframes and COBOL
description: An AI-powered interface designed to make mainframe and COBOL systems more accessible through agentic AI, potentially addressing the skills gap in legacy system maintenance.
author: hypercubic.ai

title: Show HN: Statewright - Visual state machines for AI agents
description: A visual state machine framework designed to make AI agents more reliable through structured state management, addressing the reliability challenges of agentic AI systems.
author: statewright

title: Launch HN: Voker (YC S24) – Analytics for AI Agents
description: Y Combinator-backed startup launching analytics and observability tools specifically for AI agent systems, reflecting the growing need for monitoring and debugging tools in the agentic AI space.
author: Voker team

title: Postmortem: TanStack NPM supply-chain compromise
description: Detailed postmortem of a supply-chain attack on the popular TanStack library, highlighting ongoing security challenges in the npm ecosystem and the importance of package integrity verification.
author: TanStack team

title: Andrej Karpathy: 'I've never felt this much behind as a programmer'
description: At Sequoia AI Ascent 2026, Andrej Karpathy reflected on how the programming profession is being dramatically refactored. Last year he coined 'vibe coding,' but this year he expressed feeling more behind than ever, highlighting the rapid pace of AI tool evolution.
author: Andrej Karpathy (via Simon Willison)

title: New York Times AI Hallucination Correction
description: The New York Times issued an editors' note after an AI-generated summary was incorrectly rendered as a direct quotation from politician Pierre Poilievre. The incident highlights the risks of using AI tools in journalism without proper verification.
author: Simon Willison

title: OpenAI's WebRTC Problem with Voice AI
description: Luke Curley critiques WebRTC's design for voice AI applications. WebRTC aggressively drops audio packets to maintain low latency, but for LLM voice applications where users are 'paying to boil the ocean,' accurate prompt transmission is more important than 200ms latency savings. The hard-coded implementation makes it impossible to wait for retransmission.
author: Simon Willison (citing Luke Curley)

title: Using Claude Code: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of HTML
description: Thariq Shihipar from the Claude Code team advocates for HTML over Markdown as an output format. HTML allows LLMs to include SVG diagrams, interactive widgets, in-page navigation, and rich styling. Simon Willison tested this on a security exploit explanation with GPT-5.5, creating an interactive HTML page that effectively explained complex code.
author: Simon Willison (citing Thariq Shihipar)

title: Behind the Scenes Hardening Firefox with Claude Mythos Preview
description: Mozilla used access to Claude Mythos preview to find and fix hundreds of Firefox vulnerabilities. The quality of AI-generated security bug reports improved dramatically in just a few months due to better models and improved techniques for harnessing them. Firefox went from fixing 20-30 security bugs per month to 423 in April 2026.
author: Simon Willison

title: Notes on the xAI/Anthropic data center deal
description: Anthropic struck a deal with SpaceX/xAI to use 'all of the capacity of their Colossus data center.' This was one of the biggest announcements at the Code w/ Claude 2026 event, highlighting the massive infrastructure investments needed for AI scaling.
author: Simon Willison

title: Live blog: Code w/ Claude 2026
description: Anthropic's Code w/ Claude 2026 event keynote coverage. Major announcements included Claude Code rate limits doubling for Pro/Max/Enterprise, a 17x year-on-year API volume increase, Claude Managed Agents with multi-agent orchestration, Claude Desktop app, and customer success stories from Shopify and Mercado Libre (23,000 engineers).
author: Simon Willison

title: Vibe coding and agentic engineering are getting closer than I'd like
description: In a Heavybit podcast discussion, Simon Willison explores the convergence of 'vibe coding' (iterative experimentation with AI) and 'agentic engineering' (systematic AI-driven development). He reflects on how these approaches are merging in his own work, raising questions about the future of software development practices.
author: Simon Willison

title: Redis Arrays: New Data Type with TRE Regex
description: Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez) proposed adding a new 'array' data type to Redis with 21 new commands including ARGREP for server-side grep using the TRE regex library. Simon Willison had Claude Code build an interactive playground to test the new commands in a WASM-compiled Redis build running in the browser.
author: Simon Willison
